svg.title: Spectra maintenance: application update, explicit project migration and doctor, with preservation boundaries
svg.desc: Update changes only the application installed on the machine and never reads or writes a project; migrate is a separate, explicit command that checks and then migrates one project. Uninstall is also machine-only. Doctor reports health without writes; doctor --fix refreshes generated project assets and repairs missing adapters only when safe. Preserved information is a boundary, not a subsequent action. Explicit adapter regeneration is a separate user command. Groups M1 to M4 have matching HTML explanations.
